topic.label: Research topics
topic.description: The communication questions the research is about.

labels.T_POLITICAL: Political communication, public opinion, campaigns, deliberation
labels.T_JOURNALISM: Journalism studies, news production, news audiences, press freedom
labels.T_MISINFO_TRUST: Misinformation, disinformation, fact-checking, trust in media and institutions
labels.T_PLATFORMS_AI: Digital platforms, algorithms, AI, data and society, platform governance
labels.T_MEDIA_EFFECTS_PSYCH: Media effects, media psychology, attention, emotion, persuasion processes
labels.T_HEALTH: Health communication, risk and crisis communication, health campaigns
labels.T_SCIENCE_ENV: Science and environmental communication, climate, public understanding of science
labels.T_INTERPERSONAL: Interpersonal, relational, family, and small-group communication
labels.T_STRATEGIC_PR_AD: Strategic communication, public relations, advertising, marketing communication
labels.T_CRITICAL_CULTURAL: Critical and cultural studies, identity, race, gender, sexuality, power
labels.T_MEDIA_INDUSTRIES_POLICY: Media industries, media economics, policy, law, regulation
labels.T_GLOBAL_INTERCULTURAL: Global, international, and intercultural communication; migration and diaspora
labels.T_ENTERTAINMENT_GAMES: Entertainment media, games, fandom, popular culture, sports media
labels.T_HISTORY_THEORY: Communication history, theory, philosophy of communication
labels.T_HCI_CMC: Human-computer interaction, computer-mediated communication, social robots, VR/AR
labels.T_LANGUAGE_INTERACTION: Language and social interaction, conversation analysis, nonverbal communication
labels.T_CHILDREN_FAMILY_MEDIA: Children, youth, families, and media; media literacy; education
